content.rationale: Form. The dependent is the EARS requirement, a constrained-notation child, and its prerequisites are kxyznwxu and twpvqstu (readable prose) and slwvtspu (a requirement sentence). The matrix reads natural-to-structured as a gate and structured-to-structured as its default cell — the gate form plus a flag to extend the matrix — so this is an inline review criterion applied by reading the requirement against the three recorded nodes; there is no command to run and no test path. One evaluation covers all three edges because the invocation's answer is read once against all three: the surface supplies the verb, the handle key and the whole-call refusal; the landed end supplies what a discard does to the open draft; and the store supplies what a handle names, what an unknown handle means and what retention keeps. Criterion 1 keeps the use honest by requiring the requirement to answer the surface question itself, item by item, instead of pointing at the prerequisites; criteria 2–4 are the licence checks that no element of the requirement contradicts each prerequisite; criterion 5 keeps the requirement inside the surface's scope and fails a requirement that decides any matter kxyznwxu leaves elsewhere — notably the success output, refusal wording, stream, exit status and help text, which the criteria neither demand nor accept. The criteria name no wording of the dependent and no outcome, and they are applied at check time to whatever the requirement says.
